question.text: Under which section of the SEBI Act is a Depository Participant registered?

explanation.text: The Logic: A DP is registered with SEBI under section 12(1A) of the SEBI Act, 1992. The Trap: Other sections such as 11, 15, or 30 are not the registration provision for a DP. Note: Cite section 12(1A) of the SEBI Act, 1992 for DP registration.
